role: Root-requested post-hoc association/accounting analysis of existing source13 only; no refits or causal parameter attribution

parameters_unchanged.ensemble_cutoff: arithmetic mean of individual calibrated cutoffs; no ensemble retention guarantee
parameters_unchanged.ensemble_normal: normalize mean of upward predicted normals from trained normal heads

limitations: All associations are post-hoc, with no multiple-comparison correction; not independent confirmation or causal evidence.
Fixed512 clean observations make input density approximately reciprocal to footprint area; these cannot be isolated as separate causal effects here.
accepted_planes==8 is only evidence of reaching a predeclared selection limit, not proof that raising it would help. No cap ablation was run.

Other fixed restrictions include128weighted trials,15point support, normal/probability thresholds, and intersection of hard mask with selected-plane support; losses may reflect missed/small/incorrect planes without touching8.
Teacher plane counts are automatically derived coplanar groups, not human roof-complexity labels.
Native failure contribution is an accounting decomposition of the frozen10m penalty, not independent3D measurement accuracy.

_publication.notice: All pre-existing scientific hash values remain original-source hashes. Paths are public provenance labels; published-copy SHA is in the package manifest. Metrics/numeric values were not changed.
